text_block_list.text: Uuugh... I wasn't even close to winning!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:

Trainer. Today just wasn't it.

text_block_list.text:

make a
training plan for me, but I still
bombed it...

text_block_list.text:

I did
today...

still have
reason to keep going.

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah! Yeah... What have I been saying?

text_block_list.text:

forgot what
you taught me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:

times worse
than just losing a race...

reach the
very top!
